scope: Matched development training; no hosted replay input or promotion

training.initializer: selected cold source asset; fresh optimizer in both arms
training.reward_and_sampler: unchanged from original source training configuration

development.rule: Paired signed-score clustered 95% lower bound above zero, positive combined gain against the two reweighted opponents, and no opponent-seat stratum with >=100 games below -0.10; otherwise retain control

next_gate: Only a selected treatment proceeds to independent confirmation, serving parity, and fresh hosted acceptance
